description:
Find RS3 Wiki sources for items, NPCs/monsters, quests and guides. Use get_wiki_page_content for reviewed text/page references, lookup_item for GE identities or get_item_details for catalogue records.

query accepts raw Wiki syntax; the server URL-encodes it. "Abyssal demon" "drop" requires both phrases; intitle:"Cook's Assistant" focuses titles. prefix:Category:Weapons selects Wiki categories instead of articles.

limit caps one relevance-ranked set, not an offset. No continuation cursor exists: refine the query for different matches. No matches returns an empty set; invalid queries or API failures return errors.

Public reads require no credentials and are uncached. The shared HTTP budget defaults to 60 requests/IP/minute; honor 429 Retry-After.
